Hurst.description: First contact: "Crypto arbitrage bot with volatility patterns" (cryptobot desk on Kalshi perps). A small-account, US-legal systematic trading desk and research registry: memecoin perp shorts on Kalshi perpetuals (the one live rule, armed with $1,000), Kalshi crypto event contracts (binaries at every horizon), Kalshi perp microstructure (maker/taker, order books, funding carry), the BTC volatility premium through IBIT options (data collection), Alpaca equity paper pilots (QQQ opening-range breakout, a 2s10s-into-XLF macro lead), plus pre-registration, selection-bias diagnostics (PSR/DSR, CSCV PBO, CPCV, MinTRL) and a 75-entry hypotheses registry. It began (Sep 17) as a DEX memecoin volatility bot and migrated to Hyperliquid perps research, then to US venues (Coinbase Derivatives, then Kalshi).
